entities.name: Senchus fer n-Alban
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Senchus fer n-Alban is an Old Irish medieval text believed to have been compiled in the 10th century. It provides genealogies for kings of Dál Riata and a census of the kingdoms which comprised Dál Riata.
